――それから、準備を終えた俺達全チームは、\n夜が明けると同時に島の奥へと進行を: —After that, all of our fully prepared teams began advancing deep into the island as soon as dawn broke.

皆さん、もう少しで、開けた場所に出ます……！: Everyone, in just a bit, we'll emerge into an open area...!
敵が待ち受けている可能性もゼロではありません。\n各機、油断しないように。: The possibility of an enemy ambush isn't zero either. All units, don't let your guard down.
どう見ても、違うと思うけど……: No matter how you look at it, I don't think so...

謎の備蓄施設の最奥に見えるのは、\n天に向かって反るように高く伸びた建造物。: Visible in the deepest part of the mysterious stockpile facility was a structure curving upward, towering high into the sky.

ですです！ 今のボクならわかります！\nなぜなら――: Yes indeedy! Current-me knows all about it! And why, you ask?—
じゃじゃん！ なんと今しがた、\nフィルターの全解除に成功したからです！！: Tadaa! Because just a moment ago, I succeeded in completely removing all filters!!

なんだかあちこち壊れてる？: It looks damaged all over, doesn't it?

船体の修復には莫大な量の資源とエネルギーが必要です。\nですが、アマツカゼにはほ: Repairing the hull requires astronomical amounts of resources and energy. But Amatsukaze had almost none left.

しかしまさか誰が思うだろうか。: Yet who could have ever imagined?
種としての誕生すら、あの夜空の海に浮かぶ亡霊を蘇らせるための\n礎でしかなかった: That even their very birth as a species was nothing more than a cornerstone to resurrect the specter floating in that ocean of night sky—
